guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task: finish the story, chase 100% completion, then clean up the remaining activity and collectible trophies. Expect a long haul — guides put the platinum at roughly 200 to 300 hours.
name: Vice Got a Price!

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, at the start of the game. Just play the story.
name: Just Like Paradise

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when Chapter 1 ends — in practice, once you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?. Just play the story.
name: Paradise Lost

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City. Just play the story.
name: Tits Ass Drug Money

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 3. Just play the story.
name: Vice City, Baby!

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 4. Just play the story.
name: Top of the World, Ma

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when you finish the final story mission. After it, free roam stays open, so you can keep hunting every other trophy in the same save.
name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you complete the mission Breakfast Run during the campaign. Just play the story.
name: Trust

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you complete the heist mission The Cartel Heist during the campaign. Just play the story.
name: Break the Bank

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you complete the mission Child's Play during the campaign. Just play the story.
name: Family Matters

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you complete the mission Headliners during the campaign. Just play the story.
name: DWNFALL

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you complete the mission VCIA Takedown during the campaign. Just play the story.
name: Hi-Jacked

guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you complete the mission Operation Savage Glory during the campaign. Just play the story.
name: Snow Storm

guide: The hardest trophy in the set. After the story, open Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion to see the full checklist. You do not need literally everything — for example, 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count, and 70 of the 80 Challenges. Work through the checklist itself and most other trophies fall out along the way.
name: A Long Road

guide: Leonida holds 397 stunts in total: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — you need any 250 of them. Stunt jumps are the easiest to grind: hit ramps and construction sites in fast cars. Track them under Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots, and your progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts.
name: Cunning Stunts

description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: There are 9 activity types to sample once each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. None needs to be won or completed — just try each one. Open Touch Pad, Activities to find them on the map.
name: Master of None

description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across two ranges: Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn, and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Each challenge has three difficulty tiers and you need gold in all of them. Some challenges stay locked until you meet their conditions, shown on the map. Track progress under Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges.
name: The Shootist

description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: There are 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations. Win one race at each — some charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find them under Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. Learn each course's corners on a practice run before racing for the win.
name: Top Fun

guide: Win 20 different races — replaying the same race does not count. Race locations appear as you explore; track them under Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, but if you bring your own, watch its Rating and upgrade it at Mod Shops first.
name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Take a boat with a fishing rod to the marked area and fish until you land one big enough — the catch screen shows the weight. Any boat in the area works if you do not own one yet.
name: Baited My Tackle

guide: Find an arcade cabinet — in bars and arcades around Leonida — and play one arcade game through to its end. Any game counts; pick the shortest one you can finish.
name: Stick Fiddler

description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Andy gives Lucia a strand of 5 quests, available from Chapter 3. Finish all of them and the trophy pops after his final mission. Stranger strands appear as icons on the map — clear them as you go so none is left for the endgame.
name: Road to Rehabilitation

description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Finish Kenton's whole mission strand. It ends with the mission Maritime Disputes — complete that and the trophy pops. Kenton's strand is one of the eight that also count toward Strangers and Freaks.
name: This Was No Boat Accident

description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Finish Billy's whole mission strand. It ends with the mission Hometown Heroes — complete that and the trophy pops. Billy's strand is one of the eight that also count toward Strangers and Freaks.
name: The Lone Rider

description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete any 8 Stranger mission strands across Leonida. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have one, and more strangers appear as you explore. Work through a strand to its final mission — partial strands do not count.
name: Strangers & Freaks

description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Finish all of Randy's missions, including tracking down the vehicles on his wish list. The trophy pops after his final mission. Randy's strand is one of the eight that also count toward Strangers and Freaks.
name: Supply & Demand

description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Finish all of Tyrone's missions — his strand revolves around the Kitty Litter Lab locations. The trophy pops after his final mission. Tyrone's strand is one of the eight that also count toward Strangers and Freaks.
name: Spin on This!

description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
guide: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditate at each one, and wait for the final zen animation to play — a meditation only counts once that animation finishes. This is the one trophy in the game that can be missed: one spot becomes unavailable later, so meditate at every spot as soon as you find it, and do not leave this for the post-game. Track progress under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and find spots under Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida.
name: Positive Mental Attitude

description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Bret asks you to hunt a unique animal. Follow his strand: he marks the hunt area, so track the animal patiently, use a scoped weapon for a clean kill, and bring the prize back to him. Hunting is one of the 9 activity types, so it also helps Master of None.
name: Fair Game

guide: There are 18 Collectible Card sets scattered across Leonida. Complete any 3 full sets — cards you collect can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress. Track them under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. If you are chasing 100% completion you need 15 sets anyway, so this pops on the way.
name: Don't Touch My Deck

guide: WAiNK is the phone app (hold Up to open it). Scan 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Point the phone at a marked spot and scan — each successful scan counts. Track progress under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
name: You WAiNKer!

guide: There are 80 Challenges in the game — small skill feats listed under Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges. Complete any 50. Most pop naturally while you play; for the last few, open the list and pick the easiest ones left, such as driving or shooting feats you can grind in free roam.
name: One Last Thing

description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and escape until the heat dies. A good escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow you along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It unlocks once you leave the red heat zone.
name: Hot Together

description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: With your partner alongside, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops, keep a fast getaway car parked outside each one, and do not stop to fight — speed is what keeps the chain alive.
name: Retail Therapy

guide: You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it with WAiNK. Discover 100 different ones — this happens naturally across a story playthrough if you drive a variety of cars instead of sticking to one. Track them under Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles.
name: Whip It Good

description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Trigger Combat Focus during a fight with at least 5 enemies nearby and drop all 5 before the focus meter runs out. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle so each target falls fast.
name: Gunslinger

description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Strategy from the description. The name and description point to the airport: get to Vice City International Airport, take an aircraft without going through the usual channels, and fly out. Expect heavy police attention — a fast plane and a quick climb are the plan. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players.
name: Catch Me if You Can

guide: Strategy from the description. The description is a joke about the Rhino tank — the trophy is tied to driving or fighting in a Rhino. Find a Rhino, take it for a spin, and cause the chaos its name promises. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players.
name: Challenging Tank

description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Pick a jewelry store and rob it without ever being spotted. Go at night, move slowly, use cover, and avoid the cameras and guards' sightlines. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City are good candidates. If anyone spots you, leave and try again.
name: Sneakthief

guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan each hit like a mini-heist: a fast car parked nearby, a route out of the heat, and no lingering to fight the police. Five clean getaways and the trophy is yours.
name: Maximum Withdrawal

description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then escape the wanted level. A sticky bomb or a heavy vehicle to ram it works; keep your getaway car close so the escape starts the moment the cash is in hand.
name: A Classic Blitz Play

guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map. Drive, fly and sail through every region until no grey area is left — the map fills in as you travel. Aircraft and boats make the far corners and islands much faster than driving.
name: The Goodtime State

description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations. Rob one operation belonging to each gang — hit them in turn and move on once each gang has been robbed. Expect armed resistance at each site, so go in prepared.
name: Pest Control

description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: Strategy from the description. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar or venue with a view, and order a cocktail. The description reads like a simple moment — sit, drink, enjoy the view. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players.
name: In the Beginning...

description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
guide: Strategy from the description. Drive a car through the front window of a vehicle showroom and out the other side — the classic smash-and-grab exit. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up and a fast car. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players.
name: Capital Offense

description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
guide: Strategy from the description. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a full game — follow through on every frame. Bowling is one of the pastimes in Leonida, so the trophy likely pops on completing a game there. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players.
name: Let's Go Bowling

guide: Strategy from the description. The description hints at a partnership that draws a crowd — most likely a maxed-out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time, the classic gym partnership goal. Train both characters' Strength to the top. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players.
name: Personal Best

guide: Strategy from the description. Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the game tracks how you behave, and this trophy counts the choices you make, good or bad. Just play the game your way and the count climbs. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players.
name: Actions Speak Louder

guide: Strategy from the description. The name says it all: fail at something, then succeed on the second try. Most likely it pops when you retry a failed activity or mission and clear it on the second attempt. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players.
name: Bad Luck, I Guess

guide: Strategy from the description. The description reads like a reaction to something strange — this is the game's oddball encounter trophy. Explore the weird corners of Leonida and something unexplained will find you. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players.
name: The Truth Is Out There

description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
guide: Strategy from the description. The trophy wants a melee drive-by: drive past a target and knock them down with a melee weapon from the vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and keep moving. The precise method is still being confirmed by players.
name: Ten Pin

description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists. Launder them through your contacts until you have cleaned $250,000 in total — the count is cumulative, so small batches add up. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and the trophy pops at the quarter-million mark.
name: Dime on the Dollar

guide: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything counts, and the total is cumulative. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad, Style. Big purchases like weapons and cars get you there fastest.
name: Treat Yo Self

guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800) — $160,000 in total. Each adds one vehicle storage slot.
name: Little Boxes

description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any vehicle you are driving can be registered at a Pay 'N' Spray or a Mod Shop, as long as you have an empty parking spot — the fee varies with the vehicle's value. Buy more garages if you run out of spots. Registered vehicles can then be delivered to you anywhere for a small fee.
name: On the Spot
